patch.value: Reduce context with declared answer-preservation proofs

Accept an explicit finite decision table and source-fragment dependencies. Exhaustively prove which declared input values cannot affect the answer, omit only invariant fragments, and retain branch irrelevance certificates. Coverage packing selects evidence; shared factoring deduplicates it; pm-jev proposes answers but cannot supply this proof.

Every declared routing input combination produces the same full and reduced answer with at least 50 percent fewer measured UTF-8 bytes including proofs; unsupported predicates retain evidence and report unknown; typed SDK and CLI with JSON/TOON and actionable refusals; non-git real public tracker validation; seeded 500-sequence producer/validator and SDK-state replay tests; packed npm/Bun installation acceptance; unchanged CI release gates pass.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check against main: pm CLI 2026.11.4 public context-packing declarations expose candidate selection and projections, without finite-domain answer-preservation certificates. Existing evidence-packing.ts covers criteria, shared-evidence.ts factors exact revision/value pairs, and pm-jev counterfactual.ts produces model-dependent explanations. None proves declared deterministic routing invariance. Plan: bounded exhaustive first-match equality table, revision-bound source reads through createSharedEvidenceReader, cofactor certificates for each omitted variable branch, conservative unknown predicates, common JSON/TOON producer/validator, read-only non-git and packed-launcher acceptance. This feature introduces no tracker imports, writes, retry journal, outbox, claims or mutable shared state; all tracker state remains SDK-owned.
